gap: No result ChatGPT got states that a single Growatt HELIOS 3600 can't make 240 V for a well pump: Growatt says 240 V needs two HELIOS 3600s linked through its $139 Double Voltage Power Hub, which has two NEMA L14-30 outlets and gives 7,200 W, so the whole 240 V set is one growattportable.com cart at 2 × $1,198.98 + $139 = $2,536.96 today.
standout_why: Compared against offgridbenchmark.com/learn/generator-for-well-pump and holdbackup.com/guides/portable-generator-for-well-pump, both opened 2026-11-10. offgridbenchmark has part of the idea: it says the BLUETTI AC200L does 240 V only when two units are stacked, and it lists the Anker F3800 and F3800 Plus and the Jackery 5000 Plus as true 240 V units, with prices it calls indicative. It names no hub, bundle or cart, and its Anker F3800 Plus pick can't be bought at ankersolix.com today (Sold Out, 'Price Loading'). holdbackup covers only a Champion gas generator, mentions a transfer switch without naming a product, and gives no prices. Neither page names the Growatt HELIOS 3600 or its Double Voltage Power Hub, or says what a working 240 V battery set costs in one store's cart. ChatGPT's own answer only says 'must support the pump's voltage.' This doesn't decide the whole set alone, because the transfer equipment still has to be sourced and fitted by an electrician, so 2 rather than 3.
kit_items: Power station pair for 240 V: 2× Growatt HELIOS 3600 (3,686 Wh, 3,600 W each). Growatt's page says 240 V comes only from paralleling two units.
Split-phase combiner: Growatt Double Voltage Power Hub. It links the two HELIOS 3600s for 7,200 W and has two NEMA L14-30 outlets plus one NEMA 6-20, so it is the 240 V outlet for the pump circuit.

Alternative single-store set: BLUETTI Apex 300 + B300K + Home Backup Kit (Single Apex 300). It has a 3,840 W inverter, 5,529.6 Wh, and BLUETTI's home-circuit integration kit. BLUETTI's own pages don't confirm that one Apex 300 gives 240 V (see unsourced).
Transfer equipment (inlet + transfer switch or interlock, fitted by an electrician): BLUETTI's Apex 300 Home Integration Kit ($699) is in the BLUETTI cart. No Growatt-store transfer item was found.

The plain 'Apex 300 + B300K' bundle is $2,599, $1 more than the two items bought separately ($2,598). Free gift: the product page lists a free kid's T-shirt on the base Apex 300 and on most bundles.
